race.comment: A 1600m maiden at Corowa on 2 November might provide the most reliable form line. ASHEN KNIGHT (1) started at $2.20 and took out that race narrowly after stalking the pace throughout. Gets to this trip for the first time which looks a good move. Can keep the momentum going. SOLAR ORBIT (5) made up nice ground in the run home to finish third at his latest appearance over the mile at Canberra. Remains a maiden after 15 runs but is capable of testing this moderate line-up. ISOTROPIC (10) is another maiden who has been poking around the minor end of the prizes of late. No trouble running this trip strongly so keep her in mind. FIGHTING FOX (9) next best but is up sharply in distance.
